title: Overlay moderator status response (PRF-02, catalogue module #12)
description: The overlay-facing projection of held alert deliveries awaiting a moderator plus the channel's safe-mode state, scoped to one channel by the overlay session token. It carries a COUNT and a BOOLEAN and nothing else: no supporter name, message text, amount, delivery id, event id, queue id, payment reference or viewer identifier. `safeMode` is the creator's own per-channel switch (owner decision, 2026-09-16) -- while it is on, incoming alerts route to held rather than ready. It is never automatic and it is NOT alert_queues.is_paused, which remains a different thing and is still refused by this schema under every spelling. `moderatorStatus` is null when the overlay token is not recognised; a recognised token with nothing held and safe mode off returns heldCount 0 and safeMode false.
